newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 10.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 10.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The upgrade of Hungary's army to NATO standards should not put a disproportionate finacial burden on the country, U.S. defense minister William Cohen said on Budapest.
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn confirmed plans to hold a referendum on the country's NATO membership before the end of the year.
- The Hungarian Energy Society has asked the suspension of the privatisation of the country's energy sector.
- Industry and Trade Minister Szabolcs Fazakas said NATO membership will increase Hungary's chances for European Union membership.
- Hungary is not facing floods as severe as those in other European countries.
